title: Fix crash in OUTCAR reader when CONTCAR exists but is empty
body:
Make VASP outcar reader constraint reading code, which looks for CONTCAR or POSCAR, ignore them if they are empty, in addition to current behavior which is to ignore them if they don't exist.
